## Medical Assistant using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

## Overview

This project explores a medical question-answering assistant using Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

The assistant retrieves relevant information from medical reference documents to help generate context-aware answers to healthcare-related questions.

## Objectives

* Explore responses generated by an LLM without external context.
* Implement a RAG pipeline to retrieve relevant document passages.
* Improve answer relevance by grounding responses in retrieved information.
* Examine how document chunking and retrieval affect answer quality.

## Technologies

* Python
* Natural Language Processing (NLP)
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Document embeddings and vector search
* LangChain

## Project Workflow

1. Load and process medical reference documents.
2. Split documents into manageable text chunks.
3. Generate embeddings for the chunks.
4. Retrieve relevant passages for a user's question.
5. Use the retrieved context to generate an answer.
6. Compare responses and evaluate their groundedness.

## Notebook

The complete notebook is available in this repository as an HTML export.

## Responsible Use

This project is for educational and research purposes. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Answers may be incomplete or incorrect and should be verified against reliable medical sources.
